name: Rocky Linux
preinit:
yum install -y --nobest nfs-utils fio container-selinux lvm2 conntrack-tools iptables-nft socat git iscsi-initiator-utils rrdtool
systemctl disable --now cockpit.socket
# Try to install the kernel-modules-extra version matching the running kernel.
# If the repos no longer have it, install the latest kernel+modules and reboot.
if ! yum install -y kernel-modules-extra-"$(uname -r)"; then
    yum install -y kernel kernel-modules-extra
    reboot
fi
